# GO MO Group
> Pioneering AI-Infused B2B Digital Marketing & Sales

GO MO Group is an international B2B agency specializing in digital marketing, communication and Generative AI, headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden. The agency calls its approach Pull Marketing and delivers SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), agentic web, SEA, website design and development, and ASBX outbound lead generation for three B2B segments: Enterprise, SME, and SaaS & Tech. Part of its production is based in Pune, India, under Swedish management on site, which the company describes as its main competitive advantage: scalable execution of sharp strategies. GO MO Group is part of Collaboration Art, a house of brands for Europe's leading performance agencies.

På svenska: GO MO Group är en internationell digital marknadsföringsbyrå som hjälper ledande B2B-företag ställa om för att mer effektivt nå ut till sin målgrupp. Kunderna kommer till GO MO för datadriven rådgivning och implementering för att lösa komplexa utmaningar inom digital marknadsföring och generativ AI.

## Summary

- Legal name: GO MO Group AB; founded 2013
- Headquarters: Lennart Torstenssonsgatan 8, 412 56 Göteborg, Sweden
- Offices: Gothenburg (Sweden); Stockholm (Sweden); London (United Kingdom); Pune (India)
- Size: 150+ colleagues; 100+

## Services

- [Agentic Web](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/agentic-web/) (sv: [Agentic Web](https://www.gomogroup.com/vara-tjanster/agentic-web/)): GO MO Group builds a machine-facing 'agentic web' layer on a company's existing domain so AI assistants and agentic browsers can read, cite and act on its business information. The layer has six components: an /agent page, llms.txt, schema.org structured data, a /.well-known API catalogue, a read-only public REST API and an MCP server. A standard build runs about three weeks (audit, build, deploy, verify) and is followed by optional monthly sync; the existing human website is not rebuilt.
- [ASBX – B2B Outbound Lead Generation](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/asbx-b2b-outbound-lead-generation/) (sv: [ASBX – B2B leadsgenerering](https://www.gomogroup.com/vara-tjanster/asbx-b2b-leadgenerering/)): ASBX (Account and Segment-Based Experience) is GO MO Group's in-house omnichannel outbound and lead generation service for B2B companies. GO MO handles prospecting according to the client's ICP, segment-specific value propositions, copywriting, A/B testing and landing pages, combining personalised email automation with targeted LinkedIn Ads. It is positioned as an addition to a Pull Marketing strategy, delivering warm leads to the sales team's inbox.
- [B2B Lead Generation (GO MO DBS)](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/b2b-lead-generation/): B2B outbound lead generation delivered by GO MO DBS, a sister company within GO MO Group, combining proprietary tools and expertise to find and reach relevant decision-makers. Campaigns follow a defined process from client requirements and data mining through data validation, campaign setup, user engagement and delivery of leads and impression statistics. It is aimed at companies needing large-scale outbound capacity, including global leaders.
- [B2B YouTube Marketing](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/b2b-youtube-marketing/) (sv: [B2B YouTube Marketing](https://www.gomogroup.com/vara-tjanster/b2b-youtube-marketing/)): GO MO Group helps B2B companies turn YouTube into an organic growth engine through search-optimised content, channel architecture and AI citation strategy built for long sales cycles. Engagements start with a channel audit and follow a 3-month model: audit and quick wins, architecture and distribution, then GEO and compounding growth. The service covers six areas from strategy and metadata to GEO for YouTube, paid/organic integration and pipeline attribution, and is offered exclusively to B2B companies.
- [Content Marketing](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/content-marketing/) (sv: [Content Marketing – Innehållsmarknadsföring](https://www.gomogroup.com/vara-tjanster/content-marketing-innehallsmarknadsforing/)): GO MO Group produces SEO content for B2B companies, with specialist content writers working closely with SEO analysts so texts serve both human readers and search engines. The focus is deep-dive content for complex B2B industries written from an outside-in, audience-centric perspective. The Swedish page describes a six-step process from content plan and keyword guidelines through research, drafting, client review, implementation and ongoing performance monitoring, with AI tools such as ChatGPT supporting writers.
- [Demand Generation (Online Acceleration)](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/demand-generation/): Demand Generation with Online (Audience) Acceleration is a full-funnel B2B service that takes prospects from awareness to acquisition. It combines account-based marketing, content syndication, lead capture, intent-based nurturing and measurement, integrating inbound (pull) and outbound (push) tactics. Intent data is used to prioritise in-market audiences, and performance is tracked on traffic, lead quality, conversion rates, customer acquisition cost and ROI.
- [Digital Analysis & Strategy Proposal](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/digital-analysis-strategy-proposal/) (sv: [Digital marknadsföring: Analys och strategi](https://www.gomogroup.com/vara-tjanster/digital-analys-och-strategiforslag/)): Every GO MO Group partnership begins with a data-driven audit of the client's internal and external marketing factors, followed by a strategy proposal and roadmap. Internal factors cover the website's technical structure, content and user experience; external factors are covered by competitor and market analysis. The proposal states the time and resources needed to reach the desired situation and can move quickly into implementation.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/generative-engine-optimization-geo/) (sv: [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://www.gomogroup.com/vara-tjanster/generative-engine-optimization-geo/)): GO MO Group's GEO service makes B2B brands visible, cited and recommended in AI-generated answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Meta AI and Google AI Overviews. GO MO describes itself as the Nordics' first SEMrush Enterprise AIO Partner, using a 213M+ LLM prompt database for benchmarking and AI visibility measurement. Work combines a GEO audit, competitor benchmarking, education of internal teams and structured experiments, sold as published packages from audit through implementation to an enterprise retainer. Pricing: LLM Audit & Strategy from 23,500 SEK; Audit, Strategy & Implementation from 44,000 SEK.
- [Programmatic Advertising](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/programmatic-advertising/): GO MO Group manages programmatic advertising, automating the purchase of ad space with data science, automation and machine learning to reach narrowly defined B2B audiences in real time. Campaigns run through demand-side platforms with real-time bidding and are continuously refined to match clients' purchasing patterns. GO MO positions programmatic as a cornerstone of Pull Marketing and a contributor to B2B lead generation, including C-suite awareness and recruitment use cases.
- [Pull Marketing](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/pull-marketing/) (sv: [Pull-marketing](https://www.gomogroup.com/vara-tjanster/pull-marketing/)): Pull Marketing is GO MO Group's foundational methodology: marketing to individuals and organisations that already have an expressed demand, so the company is visible in the buyer's chosen channel when they search. It is described as especially effective for high-complexity B2B sales with many decision-makers, long time-to-close and larger deals. GO MO combines people and multiple analytical tools, with search engines as the central channel.
- [SEA – Search Engine Advertising](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/sea-search-engine-advertising/) (sv: [SEA – Sökmotorannonsering](https://www.gomogroup.com/vara-tjanster/sea-sokmotorannonsering/)): GO MO Group plans and manages search engine advertising through Google Ads, buying visibility on specific search phrases to reach B2B buyers when they are looking for solutions. Campaigns are planned around search intent rather than audience, start with a data-driven audit of the website and competitors' paid keywords, and are optimised through daily, weekly and monthly tasks. SEA is combined with SEO and the wider digital strategy and supports both branding and sales goals.
- [SEO – Search Engine Optimization](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/seo-search-engine-optimization/) (sv: [SEO – Sökmotoroptimering](https://www.gomogroup.com/vara-tjanster/seo-sokmotorsoptimering/)): GO MO Group is a B2B SEO agency that makes companies visible to decision-makers searching on Google. Every engagement starts with a marketing audit of internal and external SEO factors, after which technical fixes and content optimised for buyers' search behaviour are implemented. GO MO has experience with cross-market, international SEO and combines several analytical tools and generative AI in its SEO work.
- [Website Design (AI-powered design)](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/website-design/) (sv: [Webbdesign](https://www.gomogroup.com/vara-tjanster/webbdesign/)): GO MO Group offers AI-powered design services that combine generative AI with human-led creativity to produce on-brand visuals faster and at scale. Deliverables include AI-assisted website design, creative ads, AI-powered videos, AI-generated images, social media content and branding. Work follows a four-step process from briefing to AI-powered exploration, design refinement and delivery with revision rounds.
- [Website Development](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/website-development/) (sv: [Webbutveckling](https://www.gomogroup.com/vara-tjanster/webbutveckling/)): GO MO Group builds performance-focused, SEO-optimised websites ranging from microsites to enterprise platforms, on headless CMS, Lovable, WordPress or low-code/no-code platforms. It also delivers complex solutions such as e-commerce, multilingual sites, CRM/ERP integrations and booking platforms. A typical project takes about two months from design approval to launch, following a four-step process ending in QA, launch, migration and post-launch support.
- [SEM – Search Engine Marketing](https://www.gomogroup.com/vara-tjanster/sem-sokmotorsmarknadsforing/): Swedish-language service page on search engine marketing (SEM), which GO MO Group defines as covering both paid search ads (SEA) and organic results (SEO). GO MO works in teams of SEA and SEO specialists at strategic and operational level, offering either targeted efforts or a holistic search marketing strategy. All strategies are data-based and implementation is followed up continuously.
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.gomogroup.com/vara-tjanster/digital-marknadsforing/): Swedish-language overview page for GO MO Group's B2B digital marketing, combining human expertise with generative AI. It describes AI-supported Pull Marketing services including SEO, SEA, email marketing and website-based lead generation, together with web development and design, digital analysis and B2B lead generation. GO MO cites experience from over 100 client projects.
- [WordPress Web Development](https://www.gomogroup.com/vara-tjanster/webbutveckling-i-wordpress/): Swedish-language page for GO MO Group's WordPress development and design service. Every site starts with an analysis, is built with SEO optimisation and user-friendliness in focus, and the client is guided to manage content themselves after launch. GO MO states it has built over 400 WordPress websites over nearly a decade with a team of more than 60 people.

### Local service pages (Swedish)

- [Digital byrå i Göteborg](https://www.gomogroup.com/vara-tjanster/digital-marknadsforingsbyra-goteborg/): Swedish-language local landing page presenting GO MO Group as a B2B digital marketing agency rooted in Gothenburg. It describes Pull Marketing services (SEO, SEA, UI/UX optimisation) for B2B and industrial companies, delivered by teams tailored to each client's needs and budget, combining generative AI with human expertise.
- [Digital marknadsföringsbyrå Stockholm](https://www.gomogroup.com/vara-tjanster/digital-marknadsforingsbyra-stockholm/): Swedish-language local landing page for GO MO Group as a B2B digital marketing agency serving companies in Stockholm. GO MO forms tailored expert teams, starts with an analysis of the company and market, and applies AI tools and agile methods with regular follow-up meetings and reporting. It targets both Swedish-market growth and global expansion for small and large companies.
- [Google Ads Göteborg](https://www.gomogroup.com/vara-tjanster/google-ads-goteborg/): Swedish-language local landing page for GO MO Group's Google Ads management. GO MO assigns each client a tailored team of specialists, uses AI to analyse large data sets and optimise campaigns, and works with data-driven, agile processes as a Google Partner. Note: although the URL targets Gothenburg, the page's headline and intro refer to Google Ads in Stockholm.
- [B2B SEO-byrå Göteborg](https://www.gomogroup.com/vara-tjanster/seo-byra-goteborg/): Swedish-language local landing page for GO MO Group's SEO services in Gothenburg, drawing on knowledge of the B2B market in Västra Götaland and a focus on B2B and industry. GO MO integrates AI into its SEO process and assigns a dedicated project manager who acts as strategist and change leader.
- [SEO-byrå Stockholm](https://www.gomogroup.com/vara-tjanster/seo-byra-stockholm/): Swedish-language local landing page for GO MO Group as a digital SEO agency in Stockholm, specialising in pull marketing including SEO and SEA. Engagements begin with a current-situation analysis, GO MO acts as an extension of the client's marketing department, and each client gets a dedicated project manager. It serves companies of all sizes, locally or globally.
- [Webbyrå Göteborg](https://www.gomogroup.com/vara-tjanster/webbyra-goteborg/): Swedish-language local landing page for GO MO Group as a web agency in Gothenburg specialising in WordPress, combining data-driven processes with AI. Projects start with a marketing analysis of SEO factors, and pricing is set per project based on scope, number of pages and content volume.
- [Webbyrå i Stockholm](https://www.gomogroup.com/vara-tjanster/webbyra-stockholm/): Swedish-language local landing page for GO MO Group as a full-service web agency in Stockholm building user-friendly, SEO-optimised WordPress websites. Teams in Sweden and Pune, India cover web design, SEO and SEA, and the client is involved through workshops and design approvals. GO MO cites over 400 WordPress sites built for clients ranging from large international B2B companies to SaaS scale-ups.

## Solutions

- [B2B Enterprise](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/solution/segment-b2b-enterprise/) (sv: [B2B Enterprise](https://www.gomogroup.com/solution/segment-b2b-enterprises/)): GO MO Group's offering for global B2B enterprises combines SEO, GEO and SEM with generative AI to drive top-line growth and productivity in the commercial domain. It balances long-term organic wins with short-term paid activity and is delivered by specialist teams operating from the Nordics and India. The 360° solution spans CX and digital differentiation, pull marketing, segmented outreach and training to build internal expertise.
- [B2B SaaS/Tech](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/solution/segment-b2b-saas-tech/) (sv: [B2B SaaS & Tech](https://www.gomogroup.com/solution/segment-b2b-saas-tech/)): A vertical digital marketing offering for B2B SaaS and tech companies focused on scalable, efficient growth amid intense competition. GO MO combines SEO and generative search optimization, paid search, content, web development and segmented outreach, using generative AI for efficiency and a delivery presence in India for speed and scale. The stated goal is to engage up to 1,000 key prospects annually through a targeted, segmented approach.
- [B2B SME](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/solution/segment-sme/) (sv: [B2B SME](https://www.gomogroup.com/solution/segment-sme/)): GO MO Group's offering for B2B small and medium-sized enterprises, particularly traditional industrial and manufacturing companies. GO MO acts as an extension of the client's marketing and sales team, stepping in as interim marketing chief when needed, with a primary focus on lead generation and brand positioning. Generative AI is presented as a way for historically underinvested SMEs to leapfrog competitors.
- [Generative AI Offering](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/solution/generative-ai-offering/) (sv: [Generativ AI-erbjudande](https://www.gomogroup.com/solution/generativ-ai-erbjudande/)): A structured programme to help organisations adopt generative AI, from leadership inspiration to implementation. It runs from short inspirational sessions and hands-on workshops on tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot and Gemini to custom AI strategy and policy creation and a guided pilot project. GO MO addresses integration, ethical use and bias control, and data security and compliance.
- [Digital Marketing for Scale-ups](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/digital-marketing-for-scale-ups/): An English landing page for B2B scale-ups, offering team capacity and competence to speed up growth with data-driven pull marketing. GO MO follows a five-step approach from situation and competitor analysis to weekly optimisation and reporting. The page features a video case with B2B SaaS scale-up Digiexam.
- [GEO Playbook](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/geo-playbook/) (sv: [GEO Playbook](https://www.gomogroup.com/geo-playbook/)): A free downloadable playbook for marketing leaders, SEO teams and B2B brands on getting visible, cited and recommended in AI search tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. It explains how SEO, GEO and agentic optimization (B2A) relate, what AI search tends to reward, what to measure, and gives a 30/60/90-day roadmap.

## Key Results

- [Leading B2B e-commerce player in the construction industry — We helped a B2B construction company to reach 1200% ROM](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/how-a-b2b-company-in-the-construction-sector-reached-1200-romi/): 1200%+ ROMI (digital channels, during the 2024–2025 construction downturn); 12x Return on digital investment (digital channels generated 12x the resources invested; every krona invested returned more than 12 kronor); 2x Paid search investment (client doubled its Google and Bing Ads investment)
- [Fortune 500 heavy-equipment manufacturer — How Gen-AI & SEO Automation Scaled E-Commerce Marketing](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/seo-automation-gen-ai-b2b-ecommerce/): +195% Overall organic visibility (headline result); +195% Organic clicks (compared to the previous period); 400+ Hours saved (through automation and AI, refocused on strategic planning)
- [Swedish industrial manufacturer (EUR 10B+ revenue, 180+ countries) — Enterprise Digital Marketing for a Swedish Manufacturing Giant](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/swedish-manufacturer-enterprise-digital-marketing/): 2% → 7% Share of digital revenue (one business area, India market); +318% Digital leads; -43% Cost per lead (year over year)
- [TÜV NORD Scandinavia — B2B marketing transforming you to thought leaders](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/case-tuv-nord/): +800% Website leads (from a brand new website); +175% Organic traffic; +100% Unique visitors
- [Dell Technologies — Outbound Lead Generation Strategy for Dell](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/dell-lead-generation/): 9,500 Prospects compiled (key decision-makers relevant to the offer); 15 High-intent leads; 13% Leads with purchase timeline within 6 months (share of all leads)
- [Adnavem — Disruptor competes with established actors using SEO](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/digital-marketing-for-disruptor/): +80% Business inquiries from the website; +60% Business inquiries from the website (further increase)
- [Security and alarm company — Digital Sales Process Spurred Incredible Growth](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/digitalizing-the-sales-process-to-create-growth-via-pull-marketing-seo/): 600%+ ROMI (on the client's invested capital, shortly after the new website launched); +20% Organic traffic (after the new website launch); -30% Bounce rate (after the new website launch)
- [System Edström — How a B2B company stood strong in a digital shift](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/increased-conversions-and-a-strong-market-position-through-a-digital-shift/): +700% Conversions (in some markets; Swedish page says over 700%); +100%+ Website traffic (in some markets, despite the pandemic); +30% Relevant yearly organic visits (annual goal, achieved)
- [Coor — Digital marketing across several markets](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/international-marketing-for-facility-management-company/): 30% faster Sales velocity (inbound deals closed vs deals from RFPs or telemarketing); 9/10 Vital keywords in positions 1–3 (keywords targeting B2B facility-management decision-makers); +200% Organic traffic to service pages
- [Privately owned adult and vocational education company — The SEO Strategy That Won in a Market Shift](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/seo-shift-in-sudden-market-shift/): 1.3x goal Organic traffic vs 2020 goal (goal was approximately +20% organic traffic; reached by December); over one fifth Very relevant search phrases ranking positions 0–1 (on Google); more than doubled Organic traffic since partnership start (under the earlier transactional SEO strategy)
- [West Sweden Chamber of Commerce — Streamlining Content Creation with AI](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/the-west-sweden-chamber-of-commerce-from-scattered-content-creation-to-ai-driven-precision/): -50% Time from idea to publication-ready text (cut in half); 8 weeks Time to implementation
- [Commercial property company in western Sweden — How segmented B2B outreach generated 15 Sales Qualified Leads](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/how-segmented-b2b-outreach-generated-15-sales-qualified-leads/): 15 Sales Qualified Leads (decision-makers who accepted a meeting (6) or were open to discussion (9)); ~900 Decision-makers reached (at potential tenant companies); ~80% Email open rate (~700 opened)
- [Medical-technology manufacturer — A MedTech company needed to fill the room. We did it with the right people.](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/medtech-webinar-b2b-event-marketing/): +36% Registrations vs target (over the registration target in the campaign plan); +20% Attendance vs target (live and on-demand combined); 44% Show-up rate (top of a 35–45% industry benchmark)
- [Swedish B2B manufacturer of specialist technical equipment — The first Swedish B2B website with a full agentic layer](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/first-swedish-b2b-website-full-agentic-layer/): 3/3 Google Agentic Browsing checks passed (up from 1/3 (PageSpeed Insights agent-readiness category)); 5/5 AI platforms rating the site agent-friendly; 7/7 Agent components found by every platform
- [Best Western Park Airport Hotel — Hotellet som tog tillbaka sin digitala affär med SEO](https://www.gomogroup.com/case/case-hotellet-som-tog-tillbaka-sin-digitala-affar-med-hjalp-av-seo/): ~700 → 1,750+ Organic visitors per month; +815% Page views for 'Long-term parking' content; +462% 'Book' button clicks (from 54 to 304 clicks per month)
- [Leading income-insurance company — Digitala processer möjliggjorde tillväxt för försäkringsbranschen](https://www.gomogroup.com/case/digital-marknadsforing-forsakringsbolag/): +70% Digital sales; +50% Qualified lead generation

## FAQ

- **What is the agentic web?** The agentic web is the machine-facing layer of a website. It presents the same business information as structured, readable data so AI assistants and agentic browsers can retrieve it, cite it and act on it without parsing a page built for human eyes.
- **How is this different from SEO or GEO?** SEO and GEO influence whether you are found and recommended. The agentic web decides what an agent can actually read and do once it arrives. They are complementary: visibility brings the agent, the agentic layer serves it.
- **Do we need to rebuild our website?** No. The agentic layer is added alongside your existing site. Your human website stays exactly as it is; we build a parallel machine-readable layer on the same domain.
- **How long does an agentic web build take?** A standard build runs about three weeks from audit to verified deployment. Larger sites with multiple markets or product catalogues take longer, mostly in data mapping.
- **Why does it need monthly upkeep?** Your website keeps changing, new crawlers and browser agents keep arriving, and the specifications themselves are still moving. Without upkeep the layer drifts out of sync and agents answer from stale data.
- **How do you measure whether it worked?** Four measures: the Lighthouse agentic browsing category, how well leading models describe your business when asked, agent and crawler traffic in your logs, and citation appearances in AI answers.
- **What’s the difference between YouTube ads and a YouTube marketing strategy?** YouTube ads generate views while your budget is active — when it stops, visibility stops. A YouTube marketing strategy builds organic discovery through search-optimised content, channel architecture, and playlist structure. The goal is content that compounds in value over time — reaching buyers through YouTube Search, Suggested Videos, and AI platforms without ongoing media spend per view. Both have a role, but most B2B companies are 100% dependent on paid. We change that ratio.
- **Do we need to create a lot of new videos to see results?** Not necessarily — and often not at all in Month 1. The highest-impact improvements almost always come from optimising what already exists: rewriting metadata, adding chapter structure, adjusting visibility settings, reorganising channel architecture, and building playlists. Most companies have a video library that significantly underperforms its potential. We unlock that first, then build a content strategy around proven demand.
- **Is YouTube actually relevant for B2B companies in industrial or technical sectors?** Especially so. Technical buyers actively use YouTube to understand how products work, compare specifications, and validate decisions before involving procurement. Categories like industrial equipment, construction machinery, logistics software, enterprise technology, and professional services all have genuine search demand on YouTube. The opportunity is large precisely because most B2B companies in these sectors have not yet invested in organic YouTube strategy — which means first movers will compound their advantage.
- **What is the difference between SEO and GEO?** SEO (Search Engine Optimization) focuses on ranking in traditional search engines like Google — getting your page to appear at the top of a results page. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) focuses on getting your brand cited and recommended within AI-generated answers from tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. The key difference: in SEO you earn a position in a list. In GEO you earn a mention within a conversational answer. The signals that drive each are related but distinct — GEO places greater weight on entity authority, citation across trusted sources, and content that answers questions comprehensively.
- **What is Generative Engine Optimization?** Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is the practice of structuring your brand’s digital presence so that AI language models and search engines — like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google’s AI Overviews — are more likely to reference, cite, and recommend your brand when users ask relevant questions. It involves optimizing content for how LLMs crawl and process information, building entity authority across the web, and ensuring your brand is clearly associated with the topics and problems your customers are asking AI about.
- **Is GEO replacing SEO?** Not replacing — but fundamentally reshaping. Traditional SEO remains important, especially for transactional queries and local search. But the share of research and discovery happening through AI search is growing rapidly, particularly in B2B contexts where buyers use tools like ChatGPT to evaluate vendors before ever visiting a website. The smartest approach is to treat GEO and SEO as complementary disciplines. Many of the foundations — strong content, authoritative backlinks, technical health — benefit both. GEO adds a new layer: entity building, AI citation optimization, and prompt-level visibility tracking.
- **What does the SEMrush Enterprise AIO partnership mean for me as a client?** As the Nordics’ first SEMrush Enterprise AIO Partner, GO MO has access to the largest LLM prompt tracking database available — 213M+ real prompts monitored globally across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, and Meta AI. This means every audit and strategy we deliver is grounded in actual data about how AI engines are answering questions in your industry. Most agencies offering GEO services are working from hypothesis. We’re working from measurement. Your visibility benchmark, competitor gaps, and content priorities are all backed by real AI search data that other Nordic agencies simply don’t have access to.
- **What is the Mini GEO Audit and what do I get?** The Mini GEO Audit is a free, no-commitment snapshot of your brand’s current AI search visibility. We check how your brand appears — or doesn’t — across ChatGPT and Perplexity for your core topic areas, and deliver a 1-page summary within 48 hours. It’s the fastest way to understand your starting point before committing to a full GEO strategy. There’s no pitch, no obligation — just a clear picture of where you stand today. Request your free Mini Audit here.
- **Are these designs fully AI-generated?** Not entirely. We use Generative AI to speed up and scale the creative process, but visual is reviewed, refined, and finalized by our experts to ensure quality and brand alignment.
